data.description:
## Context

Parent epic `536b` proves the ONLY lever that shrinks the blobless CI-guarded `tickets` pack is
reducing reachable commit+tree objects via **below-horizon history collapse**. This story builds
the offline rewrite ENGINE (tooling + tests + a dry-run), stopping before any prod mutation.

## Scope

Implement, as an offline operation over a disposable shadow clone, the collapse of below-horizon
derived commits/trees (enrichment-quartet duplicates, superseded `TICKET_DIGEST`s, redundant
auto-reconcile merges, and the re-emitted root/ticket trees) into SNAPSHOT-anchored checkpoints,
using core-git `git fast-import` (NOT third-party `git filter-repo` — not vendored; portability).
Reconcile the authorship ledger: re-resolve each `position` (`{ts}-{uuid}`, invariant across the
rewrite) to its NEW `commit_sha` and re-anchor `identity.enforce_since` to the new baseline so
`verify_authorship_at_commit`'s ancestry era-check evaluates consistently. Eligibility comes from
`able-tidy-massasauga`; the horizon/boundary from the `unlikely-zealous-skua` ADR.

## Out of scope

Publishing/swapping the rewritten history to any remote (that is S2) and any prod mutation. This
story's output is validated only against a throwaway shadow clone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The engine collapses below-horizon derived commits/trees to SNAPSHOT checkpoints on a shadow clone via core-git `git fast-import` (no third-party rewrite tool).
- [ ] The authorship ledger is reconciled: every `position` re-resolves to its new `commit_sha` and `enforce_since` is re-anchored to the new baseline.
- [ ] `rebar verify-authorship` is clean on the rewritten shadow branch (no unverifiable mutating event).
- [ ] Above-horizon history and all still-observable ticket state are bit-identical in reduced form before vs after (a reducer-state equality fixture passes).
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover the collapse, the ledger re-resolution, and the enforce_since re-anchor.
- [ ] [non-codebase] No prod `tickets` remote is mutated by this story (offline shadow clone only).

## Portability

The rewrite primitive is core-git (`git fast-import`/`mktree`/`commit-tree`), present wherever git
is; no dependence on any single CI provider.
data.title: S1: below-horizon commit/tree collapse rewrite engine (offline, shadow clone)
